widgets_values: No VRAM , RAM , using VAE Decode (Tiled)

如果您不想对视频进行空间分块，请删除“MMH3 Spatial Split Params”节点。时间分块也是如此（如果不需要，也请一并删除对应的时间分块节点）。如果显存充足，不建议打开。
RunningHub上运行时，建议至少运行 Plus 模式。

<Picture 1> (Storm Blade) and <Picture 2> (Inferno Fist) as character references, <Picture 3> as the exact environment background.

SHOT 1 (0-3s) - THE CHARGE: <Picture 1> (Storm Blade) sprints forward across the concrete floor of <Picture 3> with incredible speed, his cyan scarf trailing. He leaps over a broken metal crate visible in the foreground of <Picture 3>, raising his glowing cyan energy katana high for an overhead slash. <Picture 2> (Inferno Fist) braces herself near a concrete pillar from <Picture 3>, her orange gauntlets igniting with flames, ready to block.

SHOT 2 (3-6s) - THE CLASH: The cyan blade crashes down, but <Picture 2> crosses her armored gauntlets in an X-block, absorbing the impact. A massive shockwave of cyan and orange energy erupts, blowing away the dust and debris scattered on the floor of <Picture 3> in a perfect circle. Sparks fly everywhere, reflecting off the neon lights from the background of <Picture 3>. The camera shakes violently from the impact.

SHOT 3 (6-9s) - THE COUNTER: <Picture 2> uses the momentum to push <Picture 1> back, then immediately launches a devastating combo: a low kick to his knee (he hops back), followed by a spinning backfist (he ducks under it), ending with a powerful uppercut that sends him flipping backward through the air, past the exposed pipes and cables hanging from the ceiling of <Picture 3>.

SHOT 4 (9-12s) - THE RECOVERY: <Picture 1> lands on his feet but slides backward, his boots carving sparks into the cracked concrete floor of <Picture 3>. He skids past a rusted steel beam lying on the ground in <Picture 3> and uses it to push off, launching himself back toward <Picture 2> with a spinning horizontal slash. The cyan blade cuts through the air, leaving a glowing trail.

SHOT 5 (12-15s) - THE STANDOFF: <Picture 2> barely dodges by leaning back, the blade passing inches from her face. Both fighters freeze in that moment: <Picture 1> in mid-slash, <Picture 2> bent backward in a Matrix-style dodge. They hold this tense pose as their weapons glow intensely, the abandoned warehouse of <Picture 3> filled with floating dust and sparks. Cinematic lighting, 8k, highly detailed action choreography, fluid motion, strict environment consistency.
